confidence_notes: FX comes from one web search, which reported the RBA AUD/USD rate of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18. The search was for the latest rate available on the generation date, 2026-11-19. Food and drink anchors come from two web searches of aggregated cost-of-living sites (Numbeo data as republished by Expatica, MyLifeElsewhere, Expat Arrivals and Hikers Bay). These show an inexpensive meal of about $22-25, a two-person three-course mid-range meal of about $100-110, a cappuccino of about $5.70-5.80 and a draught beer of about $8 for 0.5 L. I found no reliable cocktail or wine-by-the-glass data. The cocktail anchor is based on a loose $10-15 blog range and on the beer price. The wine glass anchor is based on the beer price and the mid-range bottle price of about $17. The beer anchor is lowered from the $8 half-litre figure to a typical 16 oz pint in a restaurant, with tourist-area pricing in mind. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Boston's high hotel prices and limited hostel supply. I did not inspect any booking pages or listings. Boston hotel rates vary widely by season and event, and the July 2026 window is peak season, so these anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Boston is priced like other expensive US Northeast cities such as New York and Washington DC. It is slightly below New York for hotels and similar for restaurants.
